products.title: MAILSCREEN Suspicious Mail Isolation System
products.body_html:
The Mailscreen Suspicious Mail Isolation System helps first responders handle suspicious mail from the point of discovery through to a testing facility. This system provides an airtight method to isolate, contain, and safely examine suspicious mail and packages. MAILSCREEN provides a safe method to isolate and remove a mail threat from the premises with minimal disruption and risk to employee safety.

Minimizing the risk of letter mail threats is a prudent measure to protect employees and assets. This Mail Isolation System was developed in cooperation with law enforcement entities to combat airborne contamination threats. High-risk contamination incidents, like anthrax scares, show the continued importance of quick response containment units. This allows first responder teams to immediately address these scares and neutralize any packages that may be a contamination risk, by quarantining them on-site then safely relocating the unit to a secure location.

The MAILSCREEN Suspicious Mail Isolation System replaces and updates these Powdersafe Contaminated Mail Containment Boxes:

  • Powdersafe PS 400-2AR Contaminated Mail Containment System with Transport Case
  • Powdersafe PS Lite Contaminated Mail Containment System


Designed to safely contain suspect letters or parcels in a completely airtight environment, MAILSCREEN cannot be compromised during handling and transport once suspicious materials have been sealed within. Any package suspected to be a threat can be isolated to minimize potential contamination of the surrounding area – not just to protect those in immediate proximity, but for anyone in the building space that is sharing the same air.


Each MAILSCREEN is custom fabricated from ½” cast acrylic. This ensures strength and rigidity to prevent the case walls from bowing or flexing. Because the box is hand-constructed, it avoids the structural problems that molded plastics often suffer from at 90º angle joints, preventing any crack or torque-related handling issues. The lid is ¾” thick with an O-ring seal, held tightly to the box by 8 evenly placed clamps. The joints are bonded and sealed with a plastic solvent and completely airtight. A frame fits precisely inside the box to further support the O-ring. The interior dimensions of the box are 24” long x 18” wide x 13½” high. It weighs 52 pounds.

The Mailscreen box is constructed of clear acrylic to permit a view of the contents from all four sides and the top and bottom. The isolation chamber size provides maximum working volume while allowing to safely pass through X-Ray machines for further inspection. The isolation chamber features a built-in pair of thick handling gloves, allowing a suspect object to be manipulated without removing it from its airtight environment. The gloves are made of natural latex and are extra-thick to ensure maximum resistance to abrasion and protection for first responders.

About Mailscreen:
Mailscreen is the updated replacement for the Powdersafe Contaminated Mail Containment System. This important mailroom security device is used by law enforcement, government facilities and first responders around the world for isolating and testing suspicious mail.

products.title: Super Seer Taktikos Crowd Control Riot Suit
products.body_html:
The Super Seer Taktikos crowd control riot suit is made to provide maximum protection with unrestricted mobility, ideal for Mobile Field Force Units. The breathable lining, strategically placed perforations, and mesh fabric throughout the suit allows air movement and ensures maximum ventilation even in the hottest climates. The highest levels of protection combined with extremely lightweight materials creates advanced personal protective riot gear that is 20% lighter than comparable tactical riot suits.
The Full-Flex joints located on the elbows and knees bend without restriction to allow full movement of arms and legs in all directions, without sacrificing officer safety. Quick release attachment points rotate 360° for ease of movement.

The Super Seer Taktikos Full Body Protective Anti-Riot Suit includes:
  • Chest Plate
  • Upper Arm and Shoulder Protector
  • Elbow and Forearm Protector
  • Thigh, Groin, Pelvis Protector
  • Knee, Shin, Ankle, Foot Protectors
  • Gear Carrying Bag

Upper Body Protection
The upper body and shoulder protection system are designed with a 3mm thick polypropylene polymer shell on the outside to provide the required protection against blunt force trauma. The anatomically curved front plate is made to offer optimal chest and abdominal protection. On the inside, a shock-absorbing padded layer, made of two materials - Thermopole and EVA foam - distributes the multi-shaped pads that provide easy mobility and fit to the body. Multiple Velcro strips allow for attachment of gear, or optional POLICE insignia. Optional Molle attachment straps are also available.

Elbow and Forearm Protection
The elbow and forearm protection are composed of hard-shell polypropylene with adjustable EVA foam on the inside and covered with polyester lining. The bicep protector is attached with adjustable polyacetal buckles and web strap, while both the elbow and forearm protector has elastic straps with hook and loop Velcro to attach firmly with the arm. The elbow features a built-in articulating joint which mimics the natural bending movement of the elbow. With greater than 90 degrees of rotation, the Full-Flex joint allows for maximum unrestricted movement of the elbow and forearm while providing complete protection.

Mid Body Protection
For thigh, groin, and pelvis protection, the outer thigh shells are made of hard polypropylene plastic, while the internal side is covered with EVA foam, sewn onto the polyester fabric. Adjustable elastic straps attach to the pelvis and groin protectors, with the groin protector made of a hard plastic base with foam outside it attached with pelvis protector through Nylon web and polyacetal buckles.

Lower Body Protection
The knee, shin, and ankle joint protection consists of shells made of hard polypropylene plastic, with internally stitched EVA foam and polyester mesh, and elastic straps with hook and loop to perfect fit, detachable, and adjustable protector for the ankle joint and top of foot. The knee contains an innate joint that imitates the inherent bending motion of the human knee, permitting the greatest freedom of movement for both the knee and leg without any obstructions.

Characteristics - Maximum Full Body Protection, Lightweight, Breathable, Comfortable, Adjustable, Offers Unobstructed Natural Body Movement

Ergonomics - Impact Padding, Snap Clip Rotation Buckles, Full-Flex Joint, Inner Arm Protection, Chest Plate, Chest Pad, Body Cam Compatible

Optional Accessories - Anti-Riot Helmet, Ballistic Helmet, Riot Gloves, Laser Beam Protection, Body Shield, Carrying Bag, Cool Cap, Baton

Main Materials - Polypropolene Polymer Shell, Thermopole, EVA Foam, Polyester Mesh

Sizing - One Size Fits Most

Ventilation - Integrated Air Channels, Breathable Fabric

About Super SEER Corporation:
Super Seer manufacturers top quality helmets for law enforcement and corrections officers, including mounted police and motorcycle police helmets and face shields, correctional helmets, riot and tactical helmets, and recreational touring helmets for motorcyclists. Seer helmets are also worn by participants in extreme sports including rodeo riders, snowboarders, and others. Super Seer helmets are made in the US by hand with pride.

products.title: Chestnut Ridge CR SAFGUARD Fire-Resistant Detention Mattress with Vinyl Cover
products.body_html:
Fire-resistant, low smoke-generating CR SAFGUARD mattresses were developed specifically for use in corrections facilities and other high-risk institutions vulnerable to vandalism, arson and accidental ignition. Jails, prisons, juvenile detention centers, corrections facilities and other high-risk institutions receive maximum benefits from using CR SAFGUARD cushioning.

  • Cover made of durable 11 oz. vinyl
    • Fire-retardant, fluid resistant, soft
    • Colors: your choice of Beige or Carribbean Blue
  • CR Safguard foam mattress core:
    • Excellent flammability characteristics, even when subjected to severe "real world" conditions
    • Durability, comfort and minimal thickness loss
    • Long lasting, cost effective performance offers the lowest long-term cost per inmate to your institution
    • CR Safguard Eco foam version used for California and Massachusetts
  • Sizes:
    • Mattresses are custom-made to fit your bunk requirements
    • Most common thickness for prisons is 3". Sometimes 4" height is used for infirmary, geriatric, or other specialty purposes
    • Most common sizes include 30"x75"x3" and 30"x80"x3"
  • Type:
    • Flat - box shaped, no built-in pillow
    • B.I.P. - Built-In Pillow
  • MRC - Additional recycling fee applies by law to all mattresses shipped to CA ($18.00), CT ($19.50), OR ($22.50), and RI ($22.50)
  • Made in the USA

Benefits of CR Safguard Foam Mattresses:

  • Excellent fire performance: CR SAFGUARD mattresses will not support combustion when exposed to substantial, open flame ignition sources. In full-scale, "real world" burn testing, CR SAFGUARD displays extremely low levels of smoke generation.
  • Durability: proven to exhibit service life up to 2x-3x that of fiber-type mattresses. Typical useful service life is 48-60 months, bringing down the total cost of ownership
  • Construction: Manufactured with internal seams (except one closing seam) to prevent contamination, such as by bed bugs. Both the covering and the interior cushioning will not support growth of bacteria or fungus. The mattress cover can be replaced if damaged.
  • Advantage over fiber-type mattresses (F.R. densified polyester or F.R. boric acid treated cotton): CR SAFGUARD mattresses experience minimual loss of thickness in the areas subjected to the majority of the user's body weight. This extends the useful service life, and reduces the frequency and cost of replacement purchases. Mattresses that are comfortable and retain their original shape will experience less vandalism, thus greatly increasing mattress service life even further.
  • Contraband deterrence: Unlike fiber, the high-density foam creates difficulty to conceal items within the mattress cushioning. Fiber can be easily torn and separated, leaving hidden objects undetectable; the strength of CR Safguard makes this more difficult.

 

About Chestnut Ridge Foam
Chestnut Ridge Foam is a leading manufacturer of specialty and fire-resistant foam products, specializing in high quality mattresses for behavioral healthcare, corrections, detention, higher education, lodging and group housing, aviation, and military applications.

products.title: Norix SafeStore Soft Storage Containers and Trash Cans
products.body_html:
Norix SafeStore Containers and Trash Cans are innovative products that store personal items or house rubbish while limiting hazards and the potential for self-harm in your facility. SafeStore Containers provide a sense of self-determination by allowing those who use them to maintain their possessions in an orderly way. The product also helps facilities maintain a higher level of security when using these containers in tandem with open-storage systems that are hinge-free and ligature resistant. SafeStore Trash Cans provide facilities a safe alternative to bins made of hard materials that create hazards and potential for weaponization.
  • Made with highly durable three-ply polyurethane coated material with no ligature points.
  • Material is soft, flexible which helps to avoid it being broken down and used as a weapon.
  • Containers are radio frequency welded.
  • Easy to clean and are fluid, crack, peel and abrasion resistant.
  • Anti-microbial and anti-fungal.
  • Compliant with 16 CFR Part 1632 standards.
  • Has an open top which allows staff to easily monitor contents inside.
  • Can be re-used as populations in facility alter.
  • Made in four sizes to fit Norix Attenda Nightstand, Shelves and Open Chest.
  • Fabrication & Material: Black Max material. Three-ply polyurethane is highly-puncture resistant and inhibits tearing if puncture does occur. Fluid, crack, peel, abrasion and anti-microbial and antifungal. Resistant to tearing and delaminating for greater control. Made in the U.S.A.
  • Installation: None required
  • Warranty: 5 year limited prorated warranty against seam failure and cover material cracking. (Full warranty details available upon request.)
  • Maintenance: Use hospital-grade cleaner or bleach/water solution on the entire container. Completely rinse with clean water (do not submerge). After cleaning, dry the container thoroughly
